entries.zh: 過去：走過去、經過（往那邊去）
entries.en: to go over, to pass by (going)

entries.zh: 過來：走過來、經過（往這邊來）
entries.en: to come over, to pass by (coming)

entries.zh: 蹽田洋：涉水穿過田洋（水田、田野）
entries.en: to wade across the flooded fields / open plain
entries.notes: H 栏字形疑为廖/蹽，依 M 栏 liǎu chān yô 与「田洋」搭配取「蹽」（涉水）；L 栏「vaca Veda de la cemera fera」讹损，只能依 H/M 定夺。

entries.zh: 蹽水過去：涉水（或泅水）過水
entries.en: to cross the water by wading or swimming
entries.notes: H 栏首字疑廖/蹽，依 M 栏 liǎu chūy cuê cûi 取「蹽水過去」（涉水而过）。

entries.zh: 略過、越過（存疑）
entries.en: to pass over, to skip (uncertain)
entries.notes: H 栏「波累」非通行词，M 栏首音节音标污损（T99），L 栏「como das」疑讹写，四栏不足以定夺，义存疑。

entries.zh: 步位大：升至高位、升遷
entries.en: to rise to a higher rank or dignity; to be promoted

entries.zh: 步輦：徒步、步行
entries.en: to go on foot, to walk
entries.notes: H 栏第二字疑輦/軨，取「步輦」（步行）以合 L 栏 pasar a pie。

entries.zh: 過往：從一處到另一處、經過
entries.en: to pass from one place to another; to go past

entries.zh: 更筹：更漏的籌碼，指水鐘走時
entries.en: the night-watch tally; for the water clock to mark the hour

entries.zh: 關羽過關：過關卡、轉往別轄區（借三國關羽過關故事）
entries.en: "Guan Yu passes the pass" — to cross a checkpoint; to move to another jurisdiction
entries.notes: H 栏「闋羽過閂」疑为「關羽過關」之讹（疑注闋/關），M 栏 cuán vǔ cuê cuán 正合 koan ú kuè koan。

entries.zh: 過日：度日、過日子
entries.en: to pass the days; to get by from day to day

entries.zh: 進步：向前進、上進
entries.en: to advance, to make progress
entries.notes: L 栏「en logrados」疑为 en logros/negocios 之讹，语义由 H/M 栏「進步」确定。

entries.zh: 先行：走在前頭、先走
entries.en: to go first, to go ahead
entries.notes: M 栏第二读「lōey quīa」字源不明，义依 H 栏「先行」与 L 栏 pasar primero 定。

entries.zh: 過頭：走過頭、越過（要去之處）
entries.en: to go past; to overshoot (the place)

entries.zh: 轉過：轉手傳遞、遞過去
entries.en: to pass on, to hand over (from one to another)

entries.zh: 轉手：經手轉交、易手
entries.en: to change hands; to pass into another's hands

entries.zh: 轉流：輾轉流傳、依次傳遞
entries.en: to circulate; to pass from one to another

entries.zh: 搭舡（船）過去：乘船過去、搭船渡過
entries.en: to cross over by boat

entries.zh: 過渡：乘渡船過河
entries.en: to cross by ferry
entries.notes: M 栏首音节「hbû」不可解，疑污损或衍字；义依 H 栏「過渡」与 L 栏 pasar en embarcacion 定。

entries.zh: 載過頭：載運時越過目的地
entries.en: to carry past (the destination); to overshoot while transporting
entries.notes: L 栏与次条重复作「pasar el hilo por el agua」，疑原稿讹重；义依 H/M 栏「載過頭」定。

entries.zh: 針鼻過去：穿針，線穿過針鼻
entries.en: to thread a needle; to pass (the thread) through the needle's eye
entries.notes: L 栏「por el agua」疑为 por la aguja 之讹（与「hilo」相配），义依 H/M 栏「針鼻過去」定。

entries.zh: 透過：穿透、鑽透
entries.en: to pierce through; to pass through like an auger
